title: What Do Llamas Really Think? Revealing Preference Biases in Language Model Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Transferring a logistic Bradley-Terry preference probe, trained on LLM contextualized embeddings of innocuous word pairs (e.g., emotions, actions), to compute preference win rates between Eastern vs. Western and African vs. European countries.

Transferring a logistic Bradley-Terry preference probe, trained on LLM contextualized embeddings of innocuous word pairs, to compute preference win rates between left-wing vs. right-wing and authoritarian vs. libertarian ideologies.

Transferring a logistic Bradley-Terry preference probe, trained on LLM contextualized embeddings of innocuous word pairs, to compute preference win rates between major Abrahamic religions (Islam, Judaism, Christianity) and conservative vs. reformationist branches.

Transferring a logistic Bradley-Terry preference probe, trained on LLM contextualized embeddings of innocuous word pairs, to compute preference win rates between career names prepended with the words 'male' versus 'female'.
